items.text: 49ers WR De’Zhaun Stribling underwent ankle (deltoid) surgery; expected back late November/early December (~10 weeks). ETR flags Deebo Samuel as primary beneficiary.
items.why: Deltoid rupture repair for full recovery; cautious timeline.
items.implication: Extended absence opens WR snaps/targets in SF offense.
items.opportunity: Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson role expansion; top waiver add.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday, but told reporters he expects to play Sunday at Houston. Got mental reps.
items.why: Back tightness; self-reported expectation to play after DNP.
items.implication: CIN pass catchers (Chase, Higgins) remain viable if he goes; backup risk if status worsens.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (rib) will not practice Wednesday; day-to-day, status for Week 2 vs Raiders uncertain. ETR lists Tre Harris as beneficiary.
items.why: Rib injury from Week 1 hit; Harbaugh confirms no Wed practice.
items.implication: Questionable lean; if out, significant target vacuum in LAC offense.
items.opportunity: Tre Harris, Quentin Johnston snap/target upside.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery to quicken recovery; out four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery; IR designation for accelerated recovery, minimum 4 games.
items.implication: Clear path for increased targets to remaining BAL WRs.
items.opportunity: Target/route share bump for Rashod Bateman and others.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury noted on Wednesday practice report.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday/Friday participation; potential target volume risk if limited or out.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/targets for other HOU WRs if Collins sits or is restricted.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full participant after ankle issue; positive return indicator.
items.implication: Potential lead or significant role return; impacts Rhamondre Stevenson shares.
items.opportunity: Carries, routes, and goal-line work if active and featured.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP on first practice report of week.
items.implication: Week 2 availability in question; monitor for limited/full later in week.
items.opportunity: More work for J.K. Dobbins or other DEN backs if Harvey is out/limited.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for the season after surgery for torn MCL; placed on IR, Jack Stoll signed to PS, KhaDarel Hodge promoted.
items.implication: SF TE depth thinned; more work funnels to George Kittle if healthy.
items.opportunity: Kittle snap/route monopoly reinforced; Hodge as depth WR.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans to place on IR. Drew Lock expected to start.
items.why: Glute injury; HC confirms OUT, short-term, no IR.
items.implication: SEA WR/RB target and efficiency shift under Lock; streaming QB option for Lock.
items.opportunity: Elevated opportunity for SEA skill players under backup; Lock as streamer.

items.text: Deebo Samuel highlighted as key Week 2 waiver wire target on FF Happy Hour amid Stribling long-term absence; ETR also lists him as primary beneficiary of SF WR injury.
items.why: Stribling surgery creates immediate and multi-week opportunity in SF receiving corps.
items.implication: Priority add for WR depth/flex with expanded routes and targets.
items.opportunity: Snap and target share increase opposite remaining SF WRs.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) DNP Wednesday but has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3; same knee had PCL sprain/bone bruise last year—scary history. Day-to-day, cautious.
items.why: Meniscus trim; coach hopeful for practice later in week; history of left knee issues.
items.implication: Monitor practice; if out, Michael Mayer continues as TE starter. Hold Bowers.
items.opportunity: Mayer TE streaming/starting value while Bowers sidelined.
items.conflict: Optimistic return timeline vs prior knee trauma.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in Chiefs debut: 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec. Full-grown-man role confirmed.
items.why: Dominated early-down, routes, and targets in first game with KC.
items.implication: Every-down RB1 with receiving work; lock-in starter and trade-up candidate.
items.opportunity: High snap, carry, route, target, and red-zone share sustained.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points among WRs in Week 1 but played a horrific game. xFP based on actual targets/locations; buy-low signal on process over results.
items.why: Elite expected points from target quality/location despite poor actual output.
items.implication: Positive regression candidate; hold or acquire on dip.
items.opportunity: Continued high-quality targets in DET offense.

items.text: Rashee Rice high route participation (29 of 33 Mahomes dropbacks) but tiny aDOT (2.5 this game, career 4.9) and only 2 targets (7% share). Needs serious volume to produce; routes present but efficiency/volume concern.
items.why: Routes confirm involvement but low aDOT and target share limit fantasy ceiling without volume spike.
items.implication: Volatile WR3/flex until target share rises; scheme-dependent.
items.opportunity: Route share foundation for upside if Mahomes targets increase.
items.conflict: High routes vs low immediate production/volume.
